checkers.name: The checker shall detect and report any Operational Flow whose connected Flow Ports or conveyed Flow Item use inconsistent Flow Item types.
The checker shall detect and report any Operational Flow connected to a port that is not stereotyped as Flow Port.

The checker shall detect and report any Operational Flow whose connected Flow Port directions are inconsistent. Ports connected across a parent-child hierarchy shall use the same direction; ports at the same level shall follow the flow direction.

The checker shall detect and report any Functional Flow whose connected Flow Port directions are inconsistent. Ports connected across a parent-child hierarchy shall use the same direction; ports at the same level shall follow the flow direction.

The checker shall detect and report any Functional Flow whose connected Flow Ports or conveyed Flow Items are incompatible. For a Logical System parent connected to a contained Function, the child Flow Item may be nested in the parent Flow Item and shall be conveyed by the flow.

The checker shall detect and report any Functional Flow connected to a port that is not a Flow Port. When both endpoints belong to Functions or Functions With Reference, both ports shall also carry the same exclusive stereotype set.

The checker shall detect and report any Logical Flow whose connected Flow Port directions are inconsistent. Ports connected across a parent-child hierarchy shall use the same direction; ports at the same level shall follow the flow direction.
The checker shall detect and report any Logical Flow whose connected Flow Ports or conveyed Flow Item use inconsistent Flow Item types.
The checker shall detect and report any Logical Flow connected to a port that is not stereotyped as Flow Port.
The checker shall detect and report every Generic Flow that has not been specialized as an Operational Flow; Functional Flow; Logical Flow; or Technical Flow.

The checker shall detect and report invalid Operational Flow connectivity: a represented Operational System or Stakeholder without a valid port-to-port connection, an Operational Flow hidden from all Context or Environment Diagrams, or multiple distinct Operational Flows connecting the same pair of Flow Ports.

The checker shall detect and report any Operational Sequence Diagram that does not contain exactly one lifeline for which the SystemOfInterest stereotype is applied both to the lifeline and to its associated Operational System.

The checker shall detect and report any DataFlow message in an Operational Sequence Diagram that has no dependency to a Flow Item, or whose associated Flow Item is not conveyed by an Operational Flow connecting the Operational Systems represented by the source and target lifelines.
The checker shall detect and report any Flow Port owned by an Operational System or Stakeholder that is not connected to an Operational Flow.
The checker shall detect and report any Flow Port owned by a Function or Function With Reference that is not directly connected to a Functional Flow in its own context.
The checker shall detect and report any Flow Port owned by a Logical System or Logical System With Reference that is not directly connected to a Logical Flow in its own context.
The checker shall detect and report any Flow Item that is not used to type a Flow Port and is not conveyed by any Generic Flow; Operational Flow; Functional Flow; Logical Flow; or Technical Flow.
The checker shall detect and report any Function displayed in a Functional Behavior Diagram that has not been transformed through the Nest Function operation.

The checker shall detect and report any Function With Reference that does not reference exactly one Function, contains a local Flow Port without exactly one redefines relation, partially redefines inherited ports, or changes direction, Flow Item type or exclusive stereotypes. When the same Function is referenced at least twice in the project, every reference shall redefine all ports.
The checker shall detect and report any Logical System that is not explicitly represented as the Logical System itself in at least one Logical Breakdown Structure.
The checker shall detect and report any Logical System displayed in a Logical Architecture Diagram that has not been transformed through the Nest Logical System operation.

The checker shall detect and report any Logical System With Reference that does not reference exactly one Logical System, contains a local Flow Port without exactly one redefines relation, partially redefines inherited ports, or changes direction, Flow Item type or exclusive stereotypes. When the same Logical System is referenced at least twice in the project, every reference shall redefine all ports.
The checker shall detect and report any Technical Component that is not represented in at least one Technical Breakdown Diagram.
The checker shall detect and report any Technical Component displayed in a Technical Architecture Diagram that has not been transformed through the Nest Technical Component operation.

The checker shall detect and report any Technical Component With Reference that does not reference exactly one Technical Component, contains a local Technical Port without exactly one redefines relation, partially redefines inherited ports, or changes the port contract. When the same component is referenced at least twice in the project, every reference shall redefine all ports.
The checker shall detect and report any Use_Case that is not represented in at least one Use_Case Diagram contained directly in a Lifecycle Phase.
The checker shall detect and report any UML include or extend dependency whose source or target is not a Use_Case; include and extend are allowed only from one Use_Case to another Use_Case.
The checker shall detect and report any Use_Case that is not the target of a Satisfies dependency whose source is a Function or Function With Reference.

The checker shall detect and report any Use_Case that is not connected by a Directed Association or UML Association to a Stakeholder or to an external Operational System that does not carry SystemOfInterest.
The checker shall detect and report any Operational Sequence Diagram containing at least two represented Operational Systems when no DataFlow message is exchanged between their lifelines.

The checker shall detect and report any Condition Mark in an Operational Sequence Diagram whose formal type is not an Operating Mode owned by the Operational System designated as <<SystemOfInterest>>.

The checker shall detect and report any Action Block in an Operational Sequence Diagram that references a Function not owned by its lifeline Operational System, or whose Function is not available through Activated Function in the current Operating Mode defined by the last preceding Condition Mark on the same lifeline.
The checker shall detect and report any Lifecycle Phase that is not represented in a Lifecycle Diagram owned by its Lifecycle or by one of its parent Lifecycle Phases.
The checker shall detect and report any Lifecycle Phase that is not connected by a Lifecycle Phase Transition to at least one Start Phase, Lifecycle Phase, or End Phase.

The checker shall detect and report any Operating Mode that is not represented in an Operating Mode Chart owned by its Operational System or by one of its parent Operating Modes. A chart owned by a sibling mode or by another Operational System is not accepted.
The checker shall warn about any Operating Mode that lacks an incoming transition or an outgoing transition. A reflexive transition satisfies both conditions.
The checker shall detect and report any Operating Mode Chart that has neither an initial pseudostate nor a default transition.
The checker shall detect and report any TerminationState present in an Operating Mode Chart that is not reachable from a default transition. A TerminationState is optional.
The checker shall detect and report any Operational System that is not represented in at least one Context Diagram or Environment Diagram.
The checker shall report as information any pair of Flow Ports connected by an Operational, Functional, Logical or Technical Flow whose names differ after ignoring case, spaces and underscores.
